words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears CH ($02FC), polls joystick and trigger, updates pointer, tests key code $21 and returns on input-state or trigger.

words.name: WAIT-TRIGGER-RELEASE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls pointer setup then polls controller-zero trigger with five-tick pauses until released.

words.name: MOVE-AND-DROP-RESULT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls the movement handler at $7F76 and discards its returned action result; used after selecting a nonzero movement-menu row.

words.name: CHOOSE-EXIT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Draws the exit menu and reads its selected row. Zero redraws the current view; other rows index AVAILABLE-EXIT-LIST and invoke the movement wrapper at $720C.

words.name: SELECTED-OBJECT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the hit-map object byte in HANDLE-GAME-INPUT; object/action menu construction and inventory normalization subsequently use this value.

words.name: AVAILABLE-ACTION-LIST
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores a byte count followed by action IDs beginning at offset two. $729D builds it, $7548 displays it and $76B7 dispatches the selected ID.

words.name: APPEND-ACTION-ID
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Writes the action byte at AVAILABLE-ACTION-LIST+count+2, then increments its count.

words.name: SELECTED-OBJECT-RECORD
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Looks up resource 1's nested object record selected by SELECTED-OBJECT, returning its payload after the outer length cell.

words.name: COLLECT-OBJECT-ACTIONS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears the action list, adds action zero, walks the selected object's length-prefixed action records and appends each action ID; a nested view also adds action one for return.

words.name: ACTION-LABELS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Packed action-name vector includes NIC, WROC, WEZ and other menu verbs. One-byte records are aliases to another action label, resolved by $74FA.

words.name: DISK-CHECK-SECTOR-BASE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $01F5 (501) is added to both disk-check sector offsets. GAME-LOOP also subtracts it from $260B to obtain the -DISK CFA $2416.

words.name: DISK-CHECK-SECTOR-OFFSETS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cells $0196 and $0197 combine with base $01F5 to address physical sectors 907 and 908 in the disk-check word at $7C70.

words.name: RESOLVE-ACTION-LABEL
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Looks up ACTION-LABELS; a record shorter than two bytes supplies a one-byte alias index, which is resolved once through the same vector.

words.name: ACTION-MENU-WIDTH
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Scans the available action IDs, obtains each resolved label's length cell, chooses the maximum and adds five columns of padding.

words.name: DRAW-ACTION-MENU
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Builds available object actions, sizes their box, sets a vertical menu cursor and prints each resolved action label on its own text row.

words.name: SELECTED-ACTION-RECORD
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: $759F stores the chosen nested action-record pointer here; later action parameter readers at $7B54/$7B66 index data relative to this pointer.

words.name: SELECT-ACTION-RECORD
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Subtracts one from a nonzero menu row, then selects that action record through $4763 and saves its pointer at $7594. Row zero selects the first record.

words.name: ACTION-HANDLER-PFAS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cell-indexed table stores action-handler PFAs. $7664 fetches one, substitutes entry zero when the value is zero, converts PFA to CFA, and EXECUTEs it.

words.name: EXECUTE-ACTION-ID
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches an action handler PFA, falls back to entry zero for a null pointer, converts to CFA and executes it; handlers return the menu-loop result.

words.name: NORMALIZE-INVENTORY-OBJECT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: For SELECTED-OBJECT greater than 99, selects its cached inventory collection via $5674 and replaces the global ID with local-index+2.

words.name: DISK-CHECK-IO
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Initially contains 0= 0= ;S. GAME-LOOP replaces its first token at $76A9 with -DISK ($2416), producing -DISK 0= ;S for the two-sector disk check. Its stack effect changes after that patch.

words.name: RUN-OBJECT-ACTION-MENU
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Normalizes inventory IDs, repeatedly draws the action menu, waits for selection, saves its action-record pointer and executes the action ID until its result is nonzero; restores scene resources.

words.name: INVENTORY-PICTURE-BUFFER
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Scratch picture buffer used by $7840 to generate blank 3-byte-wide slot images and by $786C to expand inventory artwork before ?POBJ draws it.

words.name: INVENTORY-SLOT-ADDR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Returns INVENTORY-SLOT-RECORDS ($456E) plus three times the slot index; each record contains an item ID and x/y placement bytes.

words.name: ROOM-VISIT-COUNT-LIMIT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant 40 bounds $777A's count of visited room-descriptor bits and supplies its percentage denominator after subtracting four.

words.name: MISSION-PERCENT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: $777A stores the percentage derived from visited room bits here; DRAW-GAME-MENU prints it alongside PROCENT MISJI.

words.name: ROOM-VISITED?
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads the room descriptor's second byte, tests bit $08 and normalizes the result with two 0= calls.

words.name: UPDATE-MISSION-PERCENT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Counts visited flags for room IDs 0..39, multiplies by 100, divides by 40-4, and stores the value printed as mission completion percentage.

words.name: DRAW-GAME-MENU
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Prints POCZaTEK, ZAPIS, ODCZYT, GRA and mission percentage.

words.name: CLEAR-INVENTORY-SLOT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fills scratch picture bytes with $55, copies the slot x/y coordinates, writes width 3 and height 24, then draws that blank inventory rectangle via ?POBJ.

words.name: DRAW-INVENTORY-ITEM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Switches to inventory resource lookup, resolves the item's image resource, expands it into INVENTORY-PICTURE-BUFFER and draws it, then restores scene lookup.

words.name: DRAW-INVENTORY
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears text, selects RCM=2 and iterates four slot records, clearing each slot and drawing its nonzero item ID, then restores RCM=0.

words.name: w78BA
words.evidence: Unknown erased name; CFA identifier

words.name: RELOAD-CURRENT-ROOM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Disables the same-floor redraw shortcut, sets UI mode zero, and re-enters CURRENT-ROOM through $6E1F.

words.name: RESTORE-INITIAL-STATE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears text, brackets disk operations with display suppression, requires disk side one, loads the initial inventory and state groups, and restores the display.

words.name: CANCEL-GAME-MENU
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: When UI mode is one, restores initial state and reloads the current room; otherwise only resets the cursor context to the scene. It is entry three in the menu dispatch vector.

words.name: START-NEW-GAME
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Restores initial state, reloads CURRENT-ROOM and redraws all four inventory slots; entry zero in the game-menu dispatch vector.

words.name: HANDLE-GAME-INPUT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Waits for trigger release, clears text, invokes input polling, dispatches object actions and repeats until INPUT-STATE is set.

words.name: LOAD-SAVED-GAME
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Loads saved inventory cache and state group 20 with display suppressed, then reloads the current room and draws inventory; entry two in the menu dispatch vector.

words.name: SAVE-CURRENT-GAME
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: If UI mode is one first restores initial state, then stores the current inventory block/cache, writes state group 20, restores display and reloads CURRENT-ROOM; entry one in the menu dispatch vector.

words.name: GAME-MENU-DISPATCH
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Four-entry threaded switch created by CASE: dispatches menu rows to new game, save, load, or cancel handlers at $7923/$79AE/$7993/$78FD.

words.name: PRINT-DISK-ERROR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Prints BlAD DYSKOWY (disk error) and an optional marker.

words.name: PRINT-PRESS-KEY
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Prints NACISNIJ KLAWISZ (press a key) and an optional marker.

words.name: PRINT-FLIP-DISK
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Prints ODWROC DYSK (turn the disk over).

words.name: WAIT-FOR-GAME-DISK
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Repeatedly checks disk marker, prints disk-error or flip-disk prompts and waits for a key until valid.

words.name: HANDLE-GAME-MENU
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Draws the game menu, waits for trigger release, polls input and dispatches a selection.

words.name: GAME-LOOP
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Initializes the game display and VBI, then runs menu/input handling; INPUT-STATE eight restarts initialization.

words.name: ACTION-BYTE-ADDR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Adds the supplied byte offset and 2 to SELECTED-ACTION-RECORD ($7594); the first two bytes are the record length. Used by inline action text and parameter accessors.

words.name: ACTION-BYTE@
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls $7B54 then C@; offsets 1 through 6 are wrapped by the six argument words below.

words.name: DISK-GATE-LATCH
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Compared with the constant $0021 in $7CF6, and set to $0021 after the two-sector check succeeds. Its saved initial cell $7CC7 is not a room number.

words.name: DISK-GATE-TAG
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $0021, compared with the latch $7B73 and appended to the result by $7CF6; $7F76 checks the returned tag.

words.name: FIND-INVENTORY-SLOT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Scans four three-byte inventory records via $773C, comparing each first byte with the supplied item ID. Returns the matching slot address or zero; callers search ID zero for an empty slot.

words.name: MSG-CANNOT-CARRY
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: The bounded message at $7BBD contains NIE UNIESIESZ. $7FCD displays it when no empty inventory slot exists.

words.name: OPEN-ROOM-EXIT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: For direction <4, ORs 1<<direction into the byte returned by ROOM-EXIT-MASKS ($4678) for the supplied room.

words.name: CLOSE-ROOM-EXIT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: For direction <4, ANDs the room exit mask with the complement of 1<<direction. This is the inverse of $7BD6.

words.name: READ-BOOT-TAIL
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads the extra saved memory pages using HE/SP&/BDISK, then restores patched ABORT and SAVE cells.

words.name: CHECK-DISK-GATE-SECTORS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads into resource zero using sector offsets $0196/$0197 plus base $01F5, i.e. sectors 907 and 908 on drive 1. GAME-LOOP patches $76A7 to -DISK 0= ;S. The first normalized result is inverted and added to the second; the expected gate result is 2.

words.name: ACTION-ARG1@
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Passes byte offset 1 to ACTION-BYTE@ ($7B66); these bytes follow the action opcode in the selected u16-length record.

words.name: ACTION-ARG2@
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Passes byte offset 2 to ACTION-BYTE@ ($7B66); these bytes follow the action opcode in the selected u16-length record.

words.name: ACTION-ARG3@
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Passes byte offset 3 to ACTION-BYTE@ ($7B66); these bytes follow the action opcode in the selected u16-length record.

words.name: ACTION-ARG4@
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Passes byte offset 4 to ACTION-BYTE@ ($7B66); these bytes follow the action opcode in the selected u16-length record.

words.name: ACTION-ARG5@
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Passes byte offset 5 to ACTION-BYTE@ ($7B66); these bytes follow the action opcode in the selected u16-length record.

words.name: ACTION-ARG6@
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Passes byte offset 6 to ACTION-BYTE@ ($7B66); these bytes follow the action opcode in the selected u16-length record.

words.name: CHECK-DISK-GATED-ROOM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Only for destination room $0E while REQUIRED-DISK-SIDE ($4A6F) is 2: checks the $0021 latch and expects $7C70 to return 2. Success latches $0021; failure replaces the destination with $24 and clears $715A. Appends the tag $0021.

words.name: PRESERVE-MESSAGE-TEXT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores zero in TEXT-CLEAR-ENABLED ($47A4); used after action error or explanatory messages so subsequent redraw does not immediately erase them.

words.name: ACT-CANCEL
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $00 NIC to this CFA. Restores the pointer through $5390, refreshes through $59C3 and returns 1.

words.name: ACT-BACK
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $01 WROC to this CFA. Restores the pointer, sends sound command 1 and calls LEAVE-VIEW ($59A3) to pop the view stack, draw the previous view and restore its cursor, then returns 1.

words.name: ACT-SHOW-CLOSEUP
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $02 ZBLIZENIE, $12 OTWORZ, $13 ODEGNIJ to this CFA. Sends sound command 2 and passes argument 1 to ENTER-VIEW ($598D), which pushes and draws that view and centers its cursor, then returns 1. Shared by closeup and two open/bend actions.

words.name: ACT-LIFT-ENERGY-GATED
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $04 PODNIES to this CFA. Only shows the argument-1 view when argument 2 is strictly less than ENERGY ($4377). Otherwise sends failure sound $13, shows text starting at argument byte 3, and returns 0.

words.name: ACT-GOTO-ROOM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $06 IDZ to this CFA. Passes argument 1 to ENTER-ROOM ($6E1F), then returns 1.

words.name: ACT-EXAMINE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $07 ZBADAJ to this CFA. Sends sound command 7, displays the counted-line message beginning at argument byte 1 through $6D82, and returns 0.

words.name: MAX-ENERGY
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Constant $00A0 (160), used by $7E0F to cap ENERGY after eating or drinking.

words.name: MSG-GLUTTONY
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Bounded message OBZARSTWO TO GRZECH, displayed by $7E0F when consumption reaches or exceeds MAX-ENERGY.

words.name: SHOW-CONSUMPTION-RESULT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears the text area. If ENERGY is below $A0, displays the supplied message; otherwise discards it, displays MSG-GLUTTONY and clamps ENERGY to $A0.

words.name: ACT-EAT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $08 ZJEDZ to this CFA. Removes current-scene object argument 1, adds argument 2 to ENERGY, sends sound 8, and displays the message beginning at byte 3 through $7E0F.

words.name: VALIDATE-EXIT-DESTINATION
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: A one-call wrapper around CHECK-DISK-GATED-ROOM ($7CF6), used by the relative-exit handler $7F76.

words.name: ACT-DRINK
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $09 WYPIJ to this CFA. Removes current-scene object argument 1, adds argument 2 to ENERGY, sends sound 8, and displays the message beginning at byte 4 through $7E0F.

words.name: ACT-BREAK-REVEAL
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $0A ROZBIJ to this CFA. Sends sound $0A, adds current-scene object argument 1 using $7134 and redraws; returns 1.

words.name: MSG-WITH-WHAT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: The bounded message is CZYM?; used for inventory-item selection in open, cut and apply-item handlers.

words.name: ASK-INVENTORY-ITEM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Displays the supplied u16-length message after 2+, selects cursor context 2, waits for trigger release and input, then converts the returned 2-D slot selection with 2*+ and INVENTORY-SLOT-ADDR ($773C).

words.name: OPEN-OBJECT-MODE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Boolean mode used by $7EF5 to choose ADD-CURRENT-OBJECT or REMOVE-CURRENT-OBJECT. $7F45 writes 1 and $8928 writes 0.

words.name: OPEN-WITH-SELECTED-ITEM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Asks CZYM? and compares the selected inventory ID with argument 2. Success adds/removes object argument 1 according to $7EEB and opens exit argument 3 in the current room; failure shows the message at byte 4.

words.name: ACT-OPEN-WITH-ITEM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $0B OTWORZ to this CFA. Sets OPEN-OBJECT-MODE to 1 then calls $7EF5: matching inventory item reveals the argument-1 object and opens an exit.

words.name: ACT-CLOSE-EXIT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $0C ZAMKNIJ to this CFA. Removes current-scene object argument 1, plays sound $0C and clears current-room exit bit argument 2; returns 1.

words.name: ENTER-RELATIVE-EXIT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Computes the destination with RELATIVE-EXIT-ROOM ($6EE6), checks it through $7E60, verifies the returned $0021 tag, and enters the checked destination or room $24.

words.name: ACT-USE-RELATIVE-EXIT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $0D IDZ to this CFA. Passes action argument 1 to ENTER-RELATIVE-EXIT ($7F76).

words.name: SELECTED-INVENTORY-ID
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Computes 4*CURRENT-INVENTORY-BLOCK ($554E) + SELECTED-OBJECT ($7243) + $64. $7FCD stores this ID in the first byte of an inventory slot.

words.name: ACT-TAKE-ITEM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $0E WEZ, $2F UBIERZ to this CFA. Searches for an empty inventory slot, stores the ID from $7FB0, removes the selected scene object, copies/positions its picture and redraws the slot. If full, displays MSG-CANNOT-CARRY. Also handles UBIERZ.

words.name: MSG-SMOKING-HARMFUL
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: The bounded message is PALENIE SZKODZI, displayed after the smoking handler $8053.

words.name: ACT-SMOKE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $0F ZAPAL to this CFA. Action ZAPAL: in room zero it updates scene objects and an exit, then subtracts 30 from ENERGY, clamps it to at least 1, and displays PALENIE SZKODZI.

words.name: DROP-HIT-CELL-OK?
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls hit-map lookup $5147 for a duplicated coordinate pair and returns true only if the hit value is neither $64 nor $65. Used as the scan predicate in $80D0.

words.name: FIND-DROP-PICTURE-XY
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Starts from CURSOR-GRID-POS ($4D92), scans using $80B0, then translates the chosen grid coordinate by the FIRST picture origin and a vertical factor of 6. Used to position dropped inventory graphics.

words.name: REMOVE-INVENTORY-SLOT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Writes zero to the slot first byte and calls CLEAR-INVENTORY-SLOT ($7840) to redraw its empty background.

words.name: ACT-DROP-INVENTORY-ITEM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $10 ZOSTAW RZECZ to this CFA. Prompts with the message at action byte 1, selects one of four inventory slots, and if occupied removes its current-scene entry, finds a drop position, repositions its resource picture and clears the inventory slot.

words.name: ACT-OPEN-EXIT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $11 OTWORZ to this CFA. Adds object argument 1, plays sound $0B and opens current-room exit bit argument 2.

words.name: ACT-REVEAL-OBJECT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $14 OTWORZ, $32 ZAMKNIJ, $3E ZDEJMIJ to this CFA. Adds current-scene object argument 1 and plays sound $0B. Shared by open, close and remove-labelled actions; it does not itself change exit bits.

words.name: ACT-HIDE-OBJECT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $15 ZAMKNIJ, $3F POWIES to this CFA. Removes current-scene object argument 1 and plays sound $0C. Shared by close and hang-labelled actions.

words.name: ACT-OFF-REMOVE-REMOTE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $16 WYLACZ to this CFA. Adds local object argument 1, removes object argument 3 from room argument 2, view zero, and opens exit bit argument 4 for that room.

words.name: ACT-ON-ADD-REMOTE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $17 WLACZ to this CFA. Removes local object argument 1, adds object argument 3 to room argument 2, view zero, and closes exit bit argument 4 for that room.

words.name: PUZZLE-STATE@
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes the cell array at $4642 then fetches the cell. Used for puzzle flags and counters throughout the game.

words.name: PUZZLE-STATE!
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Indexes the cell array at $4642 then stores the supplied value.

words.name: ACT-ENABLE-IF-CLEAR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $18 WLACZ to this CFA. Requires state argument 3 to be zero, clears the current-room/view list selected by argument 2, sets state argument 4 to 1, and reveals object argument 1. Otherwise shows the byte-5 message.

words.name: ACT-DISABLE-FLAG
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $19 WYLACZ to this CFA. Stores zero in puzzle-state cell argument 2, removes object argument 1, plays sound $16 and redraws.

words.name: ACT-OPEN-IF-COUNTER-CLEAR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $1A OTWORZ to this CFA. Requires puzzle-state argument 2 to be zero; increments cell argument 3 and reveals object argument 1. On failure displays the message at byte 4.

words.name: ACT-CLOSE-DECREMENT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $1B ZAMKNIJ to this CFA. Decrements puzzle-state cell argument 2, removes object argument 1 and plays closing sound $0C.

words.name: ACT-MOVE-REVEAL
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $1C PRZESUN, $2B ODSLON to this CFA. Reveals current-scene object argument 1 and sends sound $1C. Shared by move and uncover action labels.

words.name: ACT-MOVE-HIDE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $1D PRZESUN, $2C ZASLON to this CFA. Hides current-scene object argument 1 and sends sound $1C. Shared by move and cover action labels.

words.name: STRING-MATCH-COUNT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Scratch cell zeroed by $8340 and incremented for each equal compared byte, including the counted-string length byte.

words.name: COUNTED-STRINGS=
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Compares both counted strings byte by byte for the second string length plus one, including their length bytes; returns whether the match count equals that total.

words.name: READ-CHECKED-ANSWER
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Draws a three-row box of the supplied width and =?= prompt, sets cursor/key-repeat controls, reads a nonempty counted answer at HERE+$10 through READ-COUNTED-INPUT ($57EE), and compares the answer with the expected counted string through $8340.

words.name: READ-SHORT-ANSWER
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls $8389 with box width $0C; the input limit is width minus 6 in that routine.

words.name: CHECK-COUNTER-PUZZLE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: When state argument 3 equals argument 4, changes overlay objects, reads the expected answer at byte 8, sets state argument 7 after a match, then clears the current scene object list and resets state argument 3.

words.name: ACT-PRESS-ADD-COUNTER
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $1E WCISNIJ to this CFA. Reveals object argument 1, adds argument 2 to puzzle cell argument 3, then calls CHECK-COUNTER-PUZZLE ($83E0).

words.name: ACT-RELEASE-SUB-COUNTER
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $1F WYCISNIJ to this CFA. Hides object argument 1, subtracts argument 2 from puzzle cell argument 3, then calls CHECK-COUNTER-PUZZLE ($83E0).

words.name: ACT-PRESS-IF-STATE-SET
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $20 WCISNIJ to this CFA. Requires puzzle-state argument 3 to be nonzero; reveals object argument 1 and opens current-room exit argument 2. Otherwise shows the byte-4 message and returns 0.

words.name: ACT-THROW-RELOCATE-ROOM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $21 RZUC to this CFA. Asks CZYM?; on the argument-2 inventory ID, copies ROOM-MAP-DESCRIPTORS from room argument 1 to room argument 3, clears the source descriptor, sets puzzle state argument 4 and displays byte-5 text. The selected inventory slot is consumed unconditionally after the match test, including a wrong-item attempt.

words.name: SKIP-MESSAGE-GROUPS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Skips the requested number of consecutive groups encoded as a line-count byte followed by byte-counted strings; nested COUNT/+ loops retain the address following each group.

words.name: SHOW-SECOND-MESSAGE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Skips one counted-line group through $852D and displays the next group through SHOW-MESSAGE ($6D82).

words.name: ACT-EXAMINE-FLAG
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $22 ZBADAJ to this CFA. Selects the first or second inline message at byte 2 according to whether puzzle-state cell argument 1 is nonzero; sends examination sound 7 and returns 0.

words.name: ANIMATION-CONTROL
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Two control bytes: low byte is the per-frame PAUSE used by $8598; high byte chooses reverse ($85CD) instead of forward ($85AC) traversal in $85F1.

words.name: DRAW-ANIMATION-FRAME
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches a resource with RESOURCE-ADDR, draws it through ?PCOBJ, and waits the low byte of ANIMATION-CONTROL.

words.name: ANIMATE-FORWARD
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Maps the starting object through $56A7, then draws consecutive resource IDs from the base through base+count-1.

words.name: ANIMATE-REVERSE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Maps the starting object through $56A7 and traverses the same number of resources in descending order with -1 +LOOP.

words.name: REPEAT-ANIMATION
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Repeats forward or reverse frame traversal according to ANIMATION-CONTROL high byte; retains the object and frame count for its callers.

words.name: ANIMATE-RESTORE-FIRST
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls $85F1, drops the frame count, and redraws the initial object resource through $56A7/$8598.

words.name: PLAY-ANIMATION
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls $85F1 and drops the retained object/frame-count pair.

words.name: ACT-SELECT-FLOOR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $23 NACISNIJ to this CFA. Compares current map floor $466D with argument 1 to select animation direction, swaps floor indicator objects, closes the room exit if needed, animates 25 frames abs(old-new) times, stores the new floor and redraws map components.

words.name: MSG-WHAT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: The bounded message is CO?; used when choosing an inventory item or typing an action answer.

words.name: SHOW-QUESTION-SPACING
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Preserves the value above the supplied message on the return stack, sends sound $15, displays message+2 and emits four line advances through $5D36.

words.name: ASK-SHORT-QUESTION
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Displays/spaces the supplied question through $86E6 then checks the typed short answer through $83D0.

words.name: ASK-ACTION-ANSWER
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears text, asks CO? against the counted string at action byte 3, adds argument 2 to the comparison result, and advances the text line.

words.name: ACT-SHOUT-ANSWER
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $24 KRZYKNIJ to this CFA. Calls ASK-ACTION-ANSWER; if the result is nonzero, reveals object argument 1 and sends sound $1C; redraws and returns 1.

words.name: SHOW-ACTION-FAILURE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears text, sends failure sound $13, displays the supplied multiline message, disables immediate text clearing, redraws and returns 1.

words.name: ANIMATE-ACTION-OBJECT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: When argument 3 is nonzero, sets four-tick frame delay and plays one sequence beginning at argument1+1 for argument3 frames; otherwise only plays sound $0B. Direction is already set by callers.

words.name: REQUIRE-ITEM-THEN-OPEN
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Asks for an inventory item using the supplied prompt. Matching argument 4 plays the forward action animation, reveals object argument 1 and opens exit argument 2; failure displays byte-5 text.

words.name: ACT-SHOW-ITEM-OPEN
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $25 POKAZ to this CFA. Calls REQUIRE-ITEM-THEN-OPEN ($87A4) using CO? as the prompt.

words.name: ACT-ANIMATE-OPEN
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $26 NACISNIJ to this CFA. Sets forward animation direction, runs $8768, reveals object argument 1 and opens current-room exit bit argument 2.

words.name: ACT-ANIMATE-CLOSE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $27 NACISNIJ, $49 ZASUN to this CFA. Sets reverse animation direction, runs $8768, hides object argument 1 and closes current-room exit bit argument 2. Also handles ZASUN.

words.name: MSG-ARE-YOU-ADULT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: The bounded message is JESTES DOROSLY?; $8861 requires the expected answer before entering a closeup.

words.name: SHOW-AFTER-COUNTED-ANSWER
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Advances past one byte-counted string using COUNT + and passes the following multiline message to SHOW-ACTION-FAILURE ($874C).

words.name: ACT-ADULT-GATED-CLOSEUP
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $28 ZBLIZENIE to this CFA. Asks JESTES DOROSLY? against the counted answer at byte 2. Match calls ACT-SHOW-CLOSEUP; mismatch displays the message after the expected answer.

words.name: ACT-REFUSE-CLOSEUP
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $29 ZBLIZENIE to this CFA. Restores/redraws the pointer and displays the byte-1 message through SHOW-ACTION-FAILURE, without changing scene.

words.name: ACT-REFUSE-WITH-OVERLAY
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $2A WEZ, $36 UBIERZ, $37 CALUJ to this CFA. Shared refusal handler for take, wear and kiss actions: sends failure sound, reveals object argument 1 only when below $C8, pauses and displays byte-2 text.

words.name: ACT-SWIM-REQUIRE-ITEM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $2D PODPLYN to this CFA. Looks for inventory ID argument 2 through $7B87. If found, calls ACT-SHOW-CLOSEUP; otherwise shows the byte-3 message with failure sound.

words.name: ACT-TAKE-PARAMETER-OBJECT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $2E WEZ to this CFA. If a free inventory slot exists, reveals object argument 1. Replaces SELECTED-OBJECT with argument 2, normalizes inventory IDs through $7684, then calls ACT-TAKE-ITEM.

words.name: ACT-DISCARD-OBJECT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $30 WYRZUC to this CFA. Removes current-scene object argument 1, restores the pointer, sends sound $21 and redraws.

words.name: ACT-OPEN-REMOVE-WITH-ITEM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $31 OTWORZ to this CFA. Sets OPEN-OBJECT-MODE to zero, then calls $7EF5: a matching inventory item removes object argument 1 and opens an exit.

words.name: ACT-PRESS-IF-FLAG-SET
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $33 NACISNIJ to this CFA. Requires puzzle-state argument 4 to be nonzero before calling the animated-open handler; otherwise displays byte-5 failure text.

words.name: MSG-ALL-RIGHT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: The bounded message is W PORZADKU; shown when $897E accepts the selected inventory item.

words.name: ACT-SHOW-ITEM-SET-FLAG
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $34 POKAZ to this CFA. Asks CO? for an inventory selection. Item argument 2 sets state argument 4 to 1 and displays W PORZADKU; argument 3 selects an alternative failure message. Afterwards hides object argument 1 and redraws.

words.name: ACT-SHOUT-REVEAL-IF-CLEAR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $35 KRZYKNIJ to this CFA. Collects an action answer but discards its result; reveals object argument 1 only while puzzle-state argument 4 is zero, then redraws.

words.name: MSG-ENTER-PASSWORD
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: The bounded message is PODAJ HASLO; used by $8A38 before an animated opening action.

words.name: ASK-CHECKED-QUESTION
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Preserves the requested box width, displays/spaces the supplied question via $86E6 and calls READ-CHECKED-ANSWER ($8389).

words.name: ACT-PASSWORD-PRESS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $38 NACISNIJ to this CFA. Asks PODAJ HASLO with box width $14 and the counted answer at byte 4. Match calls ACT-ANIMATE-OPEN; failure displays the message after that counted answer.

words.name: ACT-CUT-WITH-ITEM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $39 PRZETNIJ to this CFA. Calls REQUIRE-ITEM-THEN-OPEN ($87A4) using CZYM? as the prompt.

words.name: ACT-INACTIVE-BUTTON
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $3A NACISNIJ to this CFA. Only sends sound $15, pauses $32 ticks and returns 0, keeping action selection active.

words.name: ACT-TURN-SET-FLAG
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $3B PRZEKREC to this CFA. Sets puzzle-state argument 4 to 1 and calls ACT-ANIMATE-OPEN.

words.name: ACT-TURN-CLEAR-FLAG
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $3C PRZEKREC to this CFA. Clears puzzle-state argument 4 and calls ACT-ANIMATE-CLOSE.

words.name: ACT-OPEN-IF-PUZZLE-SET
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $3D OTWORZ to this CFA. Requires puzzle-state argument 3 to be nonzero, then calls ACT-OPEN-EXIT ($8198); otherwise displays byte-4 failure text.

words.name: PUZZLE-STATE+!
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches indexed state through $8230, adds the supplied delta, then stores through $823F.

words.name: ACT-SCREW-IN-ITEM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $40 WKREC to this CFA. Asks CO? and requires inventory ID argument 2. Success removes object argument 1, adds the low bit of puzzle-state argument 3 to state argument 4, consumes the chosen inventory slot and redraws.

words.name: ACT-EXAMINE-COUNTER
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $41 ZBADAJ to this CFA. Reads puzzle-state argument 1, maps value 3 to message index 2, skips that many groups from the byte-2 text and displays the selected message; returns 0.

words.name: ACT-UNSCREW-ITEM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $42 WYKREC to this CFA. With a free slot, subtracts the low bit of state argument 3 from state argument 4 and removes object 3 from room $1C, view zero; then calls ACT-TAKE-PARAMETER-OBJECT.

words.name: ACT-PRESS-IF-STATE-TWO
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $43 NACISNIJ to this CFA. Requires puzzle-state argument 4 to equal 2 before ACT-ANIMATE-OPEN; otherwise displays the byte-6 message.

words.name: ACT-PRESS-FLASH-ADVANCE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $44 NACISNIJ to this CFA. Requires state argument 4 equal to 2; removes object 3, animates opening, flashes the first palette byte, sets state argument 5, decrements state argument 4, clears state cell $0A and displays the second byte-6 message.

words.name: ACT-APPLY-ITEM-SET-THREE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $46 PODWATUJ to this CFA. Asks CZYM? and requires inventory ID argument 1. When state argument 2 is clear, stores 3 there and consumes the selected slot. Other cases select alternate messages following byte 3.

words.name: ACT-ON-INCREMENT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $47 WLACZ to this CFA. Reveals object argument 1 and increments puzzle-state cell argument 2, with sound $16 and redraw.

words.name: ACT-OFF-DECREMENT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $48 WYLACZ to this CFA. Hides object argument 1, decrements puzzle-state cell argument 2, and removes object 3 from room $1C, view zero.

words.name: ACT-PRESS-TWO-AND-FLAG
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $45 NACISNIJ to this CFA. Requires puzzle-state argument 4 equal to 2 and puzzle-state argument 5 nonzero before redrawing and ACT-ANIMATE-OPEN. The two failure cases select first/second messages at byte 6.

words.name: ACT-INSERT-EITHER-ITEM
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $4B WLOZ to this CFA. Asks CO? and accepts either inventory ID argument 4 or argument 5. Hides object argument 6, consumes the slot, performs animated opening, waits, then animated closing; failure displays byte-7 text.

words.name: MSG-WHICH
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: The bounded message is JAKIE; used by the final chromosome action to request a typed answer.

words.name: ACT-CHROMOSOME-ENDING
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Action dispatch table $75BA maps $4A WPROWADZ CHROMOSOMY to this CFA. Asks JAKIE against the counted answer at byte 1. Match selects disk side 2, loads resource group $16 (22), displays its ending bitmap/text, sends title tune command $50 and runs its animation until a key, then reloads initial state. Failure displays the message after the expected answer.

words.name: DICTIONARY-MARK
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Two saved cells hold HERE and LATEST, consumed by dictionary restore.

words.name: SAVE-DICTIONARY-MARK
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves HERE and LATEST into CFA8E00.

words.name: RESTORE-DICTIONARY
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Restores DP, cold-start DP/FENCE cells and latest dictionary link from saved mark.

words.name: TITLE-DISPLAY-DATA
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Data selected as the active display/palette structure by CFA8EA1.

words.name: LOAD-TITLE-ASSETS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls LOAD-ASSET-GROUP with group 3.

words.name: INSTALL-TITLE-DISPLAY
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects title display data, installs thirteen repeated display regions and a DLI vector.

words.name: INIT-TITLE-DISPLAY
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Loads title assets, installs scene and title display state, then restores DMA.

words.name: TITLE-COLORS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Returns the address 42 bytes into TITLE-DISPLAY-DATA, used as three mutable color registers.

words.name: TITLE-HUES
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Three-byte table $80,$D0,$80 used as color bases during title transitions.

words.name: TITLE-LEVELS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Three-byte table 6,12,8 used as brightness limits during title transitions.

words.name: TITLE-FADE-IN-STEP
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets each color base at its threshold, then increments brightness by two below that threshold.

words.name: TITLE-FADE-IN
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Runs fade-in steps from 12 down to zero, pausing three ticks after each.

words.name: TITLE-FADE-OUT-STEP
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears each color at its base, otherwise subtracts two below its brightness threshold.

words.name: TITLE-FADE-OUT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Runs fade-out steps for levels zero through twelve, pausing three ticks after each.

words.name: PRINT-TEXT-LINES
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Traverses a count-prefixed collection of counted strings, STYPEs each and emits CR.

words.name: PRINT-CENTERED-LINES
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Traverses count-prefixed strings, centers each at column 19 minus half length and outputs successive rows.

words.name: TITLE-SKIP-FLAG
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Set by polling START or controller-zero trigger.

words.name: POLL-TITLE-SKIP
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads CONSOL ($D01F), compares to six (START), combines controller-zero trigger, stores CFA9066.

words.name: TITLE-SKIP?
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fetches the title-skip flag.

words.name: WAIT-TITLE-PAGE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Fades in, polls START/trigger for up to 23 ten-tick waits, then fades out.

words.name: TITLE-PAGE-ADDR
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Looks up a packed text page in resource two at offset four.

words.name: SHOW-TITLE-PAGES
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Loops over packed title text pages, prints centered lines, waits/fades, exits when START or trigger is pressed.

words.name: SAVE-EXTENDED-IMAGE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Uses ordinary SAVE below HE, otherwise patches startup and SAVE, writes extra pages through BDISK and restores hooks.

words.name: BOOT-INTRO
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects intro resource base, initializes title display, shows title pages, restores dictionary, selects gameplay resources and enters GAME-LOOP.

words.name: PREVIOUS-NFA
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Computes PFA LFA @ to obtain the prior dictionary header.

words.name: STRIP-NAMES-AND-SAVE
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Patches ABORT to the intro; traverses dictionary links and erases every name except its final byte; saves the extended image.
